convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CBE_BE_CCI from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACBE_BE_CCI.mqh). The trading logic depends on this custom class whose implementation is not in the file, requiring manual analysis of the external library to replicate entry/exit rules.

other_exits: Signal threshold close (20) triggers exit when opposing signal strength exceeds threshold; expiration of pending orders at 4 bars

custom_logic_notes: The CBE_BE_CCI signal filter is a composite indicator that applies a Moving Average to CCI values. Entry/exit signals are generated based on the CCI crossing its MA. Signal strength is weighted (1.0) and must exceed threshold values (open=40, close=20) out of 0-100 scale. The CExpertSignal base class aggregates weighted filter votes, so the actual trigger is when weighted signal >= threshold. The EA uses Expert_EveryTick=false meaning signals are evaluated once per bar, not on every tick. Pending orders have a 4-bar expiration. Signal_PriceLevel=0.0 means market execution at current price. SL/TP are both 0.0 meaning no fixed SL/TP levels - exits are driven by signal reversal or threshold close logic.
python_conversion_notes: The main complexity is the CBE_BE_CCI custom signal class. Need to obtain or reverse-engineer the ACBE_BE_CCI.mqh source to replicate the exact entry/exit logic. Likely logic: CCI(49) crossing above its MA(11) of CCI values = long; crossing below = short. The threshold system (open=40, close=20) maps to signal voting weight - since Weight=1.0 and there's a single filter, the open threshold of 40 means the filter must return >= 40/100 = 0.4 signal strength to open. CExpert framework handles position management, signal voting, and validation automatically - these must be reimplemented. TrailingNone means no trailing stop. MoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size of 0.1 with 10% margin allocation check. No SL/TP means Python version must implement signal-based exit (reverse signal or close threshold exceeded).
